description: Points a root domain and its www at a 3DMockups online store hosted on Vercel. www becomes the main address and the root domain redirects to it. Email (MX) and every other record stay as they are.
variableDescription: ip1: the Vercel IPv4 address for the root domain (Vercel assigns it per project, for example 216.150.1.65). ip2: a second Vercel IPv4 address, only applied when Vercel recommends two (group site-ip2). target: the Vercel host name www points to (per project, for example f1484cc966e27e11.vercel-dns-016.com). verify, verify2: the Vercel ownership value after vc-domain-verify=, only applied when the domain or its www is still claimed by another Vercel account (groups verify and verify2).
